decls.name: FrobeniusKillingInfiniteQuotient

paper_span.quote: For \(\ell\), hence \(d\), sufficiently large, the right side is \(<d^2/4\). By Golod-Shafarevich, again as stated

decls.rationale: Step 2 in full: quotienting \(G\) by the closed normal closure of the selected Frobenius representatives keeps the generator rank and adds \(3t\) relations, and Golod–Shafarevich then makes the quotient \(\overline{G} = G/N\) infinite.
